lines.text: Many learners say: Sorry for late.
Being late! Sorry for being late.

native.tip: Kita bilang “maaf terlambat”. Di bahasa Inggris, setelah sorry for perlu being sebelum late.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Sorry for late.” 😅 Tambahkan being sebelum late: “Sorry for being late.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “being late”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “Sorry for being late.” lalu tulis permintaan maaf untuk temanmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “maaf terlambat”. In English, after sorry for you need being before late.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Sorry for late.” 😅 Add being before late: “Sorry for being late.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
